notes.title: Chefs Together - Customer Order Navigation
notes.content:
A navigation system has been added to the game that shows which cooking area customers want food/drink from when you hover over them with the mouse. 

Fixed an issue with some sfx being played more than once.

Sincerely,
Musa GUNGOR

notes.title: Chefs Together - Korean Language Support
notes.content:
Korean language support has been added to the game.

Fixed a bug with the number of customers when loading the game.

Fixed the bug with unlocking food at the end of the day when reinstalling the game.

Sincerely,
Musa GUNGOR

notes.title: Chefs Together - Launching on April 15th
notes.content:
Hello, before I start my article,[b] if you see this part, I ask you to, please add the game to the wish list and follow it.[/b] Because I need your support for a strong game release.

Since the demo I've continued to make improvements to both singleplayer and multiplayer. 

In the full version of the game I added a day and night cycle and ghostly customers.

These ghost customers can only accept orders from chefs of their choice in multiplayer mode, making the game even more competitive. 

Added an informer for the cooking panel when supplies run out, so it's easier to know when you're out of supplies. 

I've added 31 achievements in total, some of which are exclusive to multiplayer.

Fixed the issue in singleplayer where the sous chef would stay where he was in some situations.

I added the save and load section.

And I made a lot of visual edits, I hope you like it.

That's it for now, I need to rest little bit until the release of the game.

Sincerely,
Musa GUNGOR

notes.title: Chefs Together - Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello,

I hope you are having a good day. In order to make the demo more playable and enjoyable since its release, I have fixed some bugs that I am aware of with this update. If you have any bugs, ideas or suggestions that you would like to let me know, please do not forget to share them with me via the "Community Center".

For Singleplayer : 

The sous chef in the game's single mode now serves customers by looking at the food/drink in your hand. This further reduces the problem of delivering products to the same customer.

For Multiplayer : 

Fixed the Supplies trucks infinite money giving bug.
Fixed the issue of extra supplies for players entering the lobby later. 
Fixed players appearing to be behind the storage when carrying supplies.
Fixed the issue of players missing target player when interacting with each other.
Fixed the effect issue that occurs when the player exits the effect.(Screen shaking and screen blurring.)

UI improvements and text improvements have been made.

That's all from me for now, before I forget, if you like the demo, please add it to your wish list and follow it. This way you will give me a lot of support. 

Sincerely,
Musa GUNGOR
